test_title: SSC CHSL 2025 Tier-1 (Held On: 28 Nov, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Choose the option that is the most appropriate conversion of the following sentence into Active Voice.

the ancient ruins are being preserved by the archaeologists.

options.text: The archaeologists preserve the ancient ruins.
The archaeologists are preserving the ancient ruins.
The archaeologists were preserving the ancient ruins.
The archaeologists have preserved the ancient ruins.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the passive voice sentence, "The ancient ruins are being preserved by the archaeologists," the verb is in present continuous tense.
 
• To convert it into active voice, the subject "The archaeologists" must come first.
 
• The verb "are being preserved" changes
